name: doc-kit
description: Documents an agent writes for people, in one look: manuals in pictures, explainers for one reader, chaptered books, D2 diagrams and decks, simulated first readers, a lint for Japanese prose (yomiyasu). Pages are one self-contained dark HTML file built from a fixed set of parts (daisyUI 5 on Tailwind 4, prebuilt) and checked by a script.
